result.question: Where did the man of God go after the old prophet lied to him?

readings.support: the prophet who had brought him back | in his house

assessments.reason: The passage says he “ate bread in his house,” referring to the prophet who brought him back, so “to the prophet’s house” matches “Back to the old prophet’s house.”
“Back with him” repeats accompaniment (“went back with him”) but does not specify the location asked for (“where”), which the text identifies as the prophet’s house.

result.reason: The text explicitly states the man of God ate bread “in his house,” identifying the destination as the old prophet’s house.
